newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firm, fuel oil bid up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, fuel oil bid up.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed on Wednesday morning, fuel oil bolstered by the aggressive bidding of one trading house, dealers said.

The trading house bid at $85.50/$86 for high sulphur fuel oil barges for the whole of or for second half April delivery. Some dealers believed it wished to benefit a long swaps position. Prompt offers were at $86 fob Rotterdam, a $1 gain from Tuesday's close. Bunker demand was thin.
Heating oil barges were up almost $1 a tonne as April IPE gas oil futures gained. Prompt offers remained at around April IPE +50 cents.
